## Create ONLY these 4 files
```
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.stories.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.test.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/zimmProductCardContent.css.ts
```
Plus register the new recipe in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` — one import line, one entry in the `components` export object. Do not touch any other line in that file. Do not touch any file outside this list — in particular do NOT touch `zimmSlideIndicator/`, `zimmSizeChip*/`, `zimmProductPrice/`, or `zimmProductCardMedia/` (all already committed from prior steps).

## CRITICAL — two things from the original plan are now WRONG, read this before writing anything
1. **No badge.** An earlier version of this plan moved a badge slot into `ZimmProductCardMedia` (Step 4). That slot has since been **removed entirely** — Marcel confirmed no design requires a badge on the image, and it was not moved anywhere else. **Do not build a badge slot in this component either.** This component has no `badge` prop, no badge rendering, nothing. The SFCC-236 AC's mention of "badge" for PLP/Wishlist is currently unbuilt anywhere in this codebase — that's a known, accepted gap, not something for you to fill by guessing a home for it.
2. **No remove/close button.** The wishlist remove ('x') CTA lives entirely in `ZimmProductCardMedia` (the `close` overlay, built in Step 4) — it is positioned on the image, not in this text-content component. Do not add `onRemove`/`removeLabel` props or any remove-button rendering here.

## Read these exemplars FIRST, in full, before writing anything
1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` and `.css.ts` (Step 4, just committed) — for the current, correct shape of this component family: `data-card-slot` contract comments, how `useMultiStyleConfig` is called, `chakra.*`/`__css` usage, `defineMessages`/`useIntl` pattern, JSDoc style.
2. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductName/index.tsx` — you will compose this atom for the product name/heading.
3. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx` — you will compose this atom for price, **passing `isLive={false}`** (see below).
4. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/index.tsx` and its sibling `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmSizeChip/index.tsx` (Step 2, already committed) — you will compose `ZimmSizeChipGroup` for the size-picker slot.
5. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductMeta/index.tsx` — an existing molecule that composes multiple product-info atoms together; useful as a second reference for how this codebase composes atoms into a text-block molecule (distinct from the image-focused `zimmProductCardMedia` reference above).

## Design source (verified Figma — do not re-derive)
`Card-content` component set, node `40002109:26908` (Desktop `40002109:26906` / Mobile `40002163:37103`). Verified internal structure of the Desktop variant:
```
Content(40,32,208x138)
  > Frame(208x82)
      > Product name and attributes(208x49)
          > Product name and icons(208x25)
              > Card heading instance (176x25)   <- product name
              > Icons(184,0,24x24) > touchContainer(24x24) > Icon_bag instance(4,4,16x16)  <- bag button
          > Attributes(0,41,208x8)
              > Colour text (53x8)
              > Size text (43x8)
      > Price text (0,73,208x9)
      > Size Selector instance (0,106,208x28, hidden=true)  <- hidden by default, reveals on hover (organism's job, Step 6)
  > Link instance (0,114,57x24)
```
**Confirmed in Figma directly (from an earlier resolution in this build): it's a BAG icon (`Icon_bag`), not a wishlist star** — SPR-14/SPR-15 (the signed-off functional requirements) were amended from wishlist to cart/bag, and this matches. Do not build a wishlist heart here.

## Component contract
Props — this component takes **booleans/values derived from the organism's variation logic (Step 6, not built yet)**, never a `variation` string literal, so it never needs to know variation names:
```ts
type ZimmProductCardContentProps = {
  name: string;
  headingLevel: 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4'; // matches ZimmProductName's own headingLevel-shaped prop — check its exact type and reuse/match it, don't invent a parallel shape
  href: string; // the name renders as a link to the PDP
  currentPrice?: string;
  originalPrice?: string;
  isPriceLoading?: boolean; // passthrough to ZimmProductPrice's own isLoading

  showAttributes: boolean; // wishlist only, per the organism's VARIATION_CONFIG (not built yet — this component just takes the boolean)
  colour?: string; // rendered only when showAttributes is true
  size?: string;   // rendered only when showAttributes is true

  showBag: boolean;
  isUnavailable?: boolean; // disables the bag button when true
  onAddToBag?: () => void;

  showSizeChips: boolean; // PLP only, per the organism's config
  sizeChipValues?: ZimmSizeChipValue[]; // re-export or import the type from zimmSizeChipGroup — check its exact export name
  selectedSizeChipValue?: string;
  onSizeChipSelect?: (value: string) => void;

  showNotifyMe: boolean; // true only when isUnavailable && a notify-me callback is usable
  onNotifyMe?: () => void;
};
```
Use your judgement on any prop naming/shape adjustment needed once you've read the actual exports of `ZimmProductName`, `ZimmProductPrice`, and `ZimmSizeChipGroup` — match their real prop shapes exactly rather than guessing types, and document any deviation from the sketch above in your report.

## Behaviour and exact pass criteria

**Bag control:**
- Native `<button>`, `aria-label` via `defineMessages`/`useIntl` (this is a BAG action, e.g. "Add to bag" — not a wishlist label), rendered only when `showBag` is true.
- Hit area ≥24×24 matching Figma's `touchContainer` (24×24 exactly).
- Uses `ZimmIcon` with the bag icon type — check the actual icon name/type string in `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmIcon/index.tsx`'s icon map (grep for "bag") and use whatever the real registered name is.
- **Hover and active states: no Figma spec for either on this control** (same situation as `ZimmSizeChip` in Step 2, and `close`/`arrowButton` in Step 4 before their focus-ring fix) — do NOT invent `_hover`. **DO add `_focusVisible`** using the same universal `var(--zimm-focus-ring)` / `var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)` pair every other interactive control in this build uses (`zimmColourSwatch`, `zimmNavItem`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup`'s `pageButton`, and Step 4's `close`/`arrowButton`/`scrollContainer`) — this was a real, confirmed gap the Tester/Scorer caught TWICE already in this build (Step 2 and Step 4); do not reintroduce it a third time.
- Disabled (native `disabled` attribute, not just a visual grey-out) when `isUnavailable` is true — and `onAddToBag` must never fire in that state (this is testable: click a disabled native button and confirm the handler wasn't called).

**Attributes row (colour + size text, wishlist only):**
- Renders `colour` and `size` as visible text when `showAttributes` is true.
- **Absent from the DOM entirely** (not just visually hidden — don't render the container at all) when `showAttributes` is false. This is a specific, deliberate distinction the plan calls out — verify your test actually checks `queryBy...` returns `null`, not just that something has `display:none`.

**Price:**
- Composes `ZimmProductPrice`, **always passing `isLive={false}`** — this is the entire reason that prop was added in Step 3. Do not omit it (which would silently default to `true` and reintroduce the exact problem Step 3 fixed — 60 live regions on a PLP grid that never change after mount).
- Present in the DOM for every configuration (not conditionally rendered based on variation) — hover-based reveal/hide of price is a CSS concern for the organism (Step 6) to implement on top of this component's always-rendered output, not something this component does itself.
- Pass `originalPrice`/`currentPrice`/`isLoading={isPriceLoading}` straight through.

**Size chip slot:**
- Composes `ZimmSizeChipGroup` when `showSizeChips` is true, passing `sizeChipValues`/`selectedSizeChipValue`/`onSizeChipSelect` straight through (check the real prop names on `ZimmSizeChipGroup` and match exactly).
- Per Figma, this slot is `hidden={true}` by default (`Size Selector instance (0,106,208x28, hidden=true)`) — **this component should render it in the DOM unconditionally whenever `showSizeChips` is true** (matching the "always in DOM, CSS reveals on hover" precedent already established in Step 4 for arrows/indicator) — the actual hover-reveal CSS is the organism's job (Step 6), not this component's. This component's own recipe should NOT itself hide this part by default via `display:none` — that would fight against whatever the organism's hover-reveal CSS tries to do. Just render it plainly; Step 6 handles visibility.
- Absent entirely (not rendered) when `showSizeChips` is false.

**Notify-me control:**
- Renders only when `showNotifyMe` is true AND `onNotifyMe` is supplied (both conditions, matching the plan's stated default from an earlier open question: "a `<button>` invoking optional `onNotifyMe`, rendering nothing when absent").
- Native `<button>`, real `aria-label`/visible text via `defineMessages` (e.g. "Notify me when back in stock"), `_focusVisible` ring same as the bag button.
- No ticket exists specifying its exact destination/behaviour beyond "invokes a callback" — keep it simple, a plain button calling `onNotifyMe()`, nothing more.

**Name/heading:**
- Composes `ZimmProductName`, passing `name`/`headingLevel`/`href` (or whatever its real prop names are — check the file) — exactly one heading per card, at the caller's `headingLevel`.
- This is a link to the PDP — check how `ZimmProductName` itself handles the link (does it render its own `<a>`, or does this component need to wrap it?) by reading its source; match whatever pattern it already uses rather than double-wrapping in a second anchor.

**Responsive:**
- Desktop/Mobile sizing differences (per the two Figma variants, 208x82 vs a narrower mobile width) should be expressed as an explicit `@media (min-width: ...)` block in the recipe — check `overrides/app/theme/foundation/gridSystem.ts`'s registered breakpoints and use the same 768px-equivalent boundary Step 4 used (`HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY`'s sibling concept — check if a shared breakpoint constant already exists anywhere in `ui-kits/` you should reuse, e.g. `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts` or similar, rather than inventing a new one). If genuinely nothing differs in a way that needs a media query (e.g. if the content just reflows naturally via the fluid parent), say so in your report rather than adding an empty/unnecessary media query.
- All type via `textStyle`, never raw `fontSize`.

## Recipe file (`zimmProductCardContent.css.ts`)
- `parts` array covering root, name/heading wrapper, icons/bag wrapper, bag button, attributes row, price wrapper, size-chip wrapper, notify-me button — exact naming your call, must exactly match every `styles.X` read in `index.tsx` (`recipeParts.test.ts` enforces this).
- All colour/spacing as `var(--zimm-*)` — check `spacing.ts`/`sizes.ts` first. No bare Chakra token keys anywhere (`recipeGuards.test.ts` hard gate).
- Recipe key is the literal string `'ZimmProductCardContent'` — does not collide with any base SFCC recipe name.
- Responsive via explicit media queries only, never Chakra array shorthand.

## Stories
`title: 'Commerce/ZimmProductCardContent'`. Mandatory `Default` export. Named exports covering: `WithAttributes` (wishlist-shaped: colour+size shown), `WithSizeChips` (PLP-shaped), `Unavailable` (bag disabled + notify-me shown), `LoadingPrice`. No `play` needed unless there's genuine interactive behaviour worth asserting beyond what the component tests already cover (your call).

## Tests
Vitest + RTL. Mock `useMultiStyleConfig` to a flat parts object per this build's established pattern. Mock the icons barrel (known Vitest SVG side-effect issue, per `.claude/rules/testing.md`). Wrap in `IntlProvider` + whatever `ZimmProductName`'s own link-rendering needs (check if it needs a Router context — `MemoryRouter` — by reading how `zimmProductCardMedia`'s tests or `zimmColourSwatchGroup`'s tests handle a component that renders a route-aware link, if applicable). Cover every pass criterion above explicitly, including: attributes row absent from DOM (not hidden) when `showAttributes=false`; bag disabled+silent when `isUnavailable`; notify-me only when both conditions hold; size-chip slot rendered-but-not-hidden-by-this-component's-own-CSS when active; `isLive={false}` is genuinely passed to `ZimmProductPrice` (you can assert this by checking the rendered price element does NOT carry `aria-live`, matching Step 3's own test pattern for confirming the false case).

**Also add the same "test the real, unmocked recipe" structural check this build has now used twice (Step 2's `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts`, Step 4's Fix-1 structural test) if there is any correctness-critical CSS-only behaviour in this recipe that the mocked component tests can't see** — e.g. if you do end up needing a media query for desktop/mobile sizing, add one assertion importing the real recipe module directly and checking the media-query key resolves the way you intend, so this doesn't join Step 4's "zero regression coverage on real CSS" gap that had to be caught and fixed after the fact.

## House rules
TypeScript only. Australian spelling ("colour", not "color", in any new identifiers/comments — note the prop is literally named `colour` per the Figma "Colour" attribute label). No `any` without a comment. No non-null assertion without a comment. No hardcoded design-value literal outside `var(--zimm-*)`. No `console.log`. Do not modify `package.json`.

## When done
Report the exact file list with line counts, confirm nothing outside this list was touched, confirm any prop-shape deviations from the sketch above (and why), and confirm these are all clean:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts
npx vitest run overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
npm run test
```
Baseline going into this step: 50 files / 765 tests (after Step 4's badge removal). Report the new total. Do NOT stage or commit anything.
